title: Check Real-Time Tipper and Hospital Tags in the Ignition Tag Application
summary: Use the Ignition gateway tag application, rather than a Perspective project, to inspect real-time OptiSweep tags. Verify that mapped tipper, hospital, and SYS1 tags are present, readable, and updating as live tag values.
when_to_use: Use this Ignition gateway diagnostic when verifying whether mapped tipper, hospital, and SYS1 tags are available as real-time values for OptiSweep communication and downstream AVEVA reading.
not_for: Do not use a Perspective project for this check; use the Ignition gateway tag application.
Do not use this procedure to write tags, change tag-provider mappings, or modify Ignition configuration.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Inspect the Ignition gateway tag application and identify absent, unavailable, unreadable, or non-updating mapped tags.
Review the diagnostic when the Ignition tag application cannot display mapped tags or their values do not update.

safety_notes: This is a read-only diagnostic; do not perform tag writes or configuration changes during the check.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the mapped tag providers and tags for AvevaTest, TIPPERS, Hospital1, and SYS1

access_required: L1/L2 access to the Ignition gateway and tag application
system_preconditions: The live Ignition gateway is available for inspection.

visual_references.description: Ignition tag mapping view showing AvevaTest, GLDStation1a, GLDStation1b, GLDStation2a, GLDStation2b, Hospital1, TIPPERS, SYS1, TipperStation tags, and TS_1A through TS_8B.

steps.title: Open the Ignition gateway tag application
steps.purpose: Access the live tag view used to inspect real-time OptiSweep values.
steps.instruction: In the Ignition gateway, open the tag application and its real-time tag view. Do not use a Perspective project for this check.
steps.expected_result: The Ignition gateway tag application opens with a tag tree or tag list and live value fields available for inspection.
steps.healthy_condition: The Ignition tag application is accessible and displays the real-time tag view.
steps.failure_condition: The tag application cannot be opened, does not expose the real-time tag view, or only a Perspective project is available.

actions.label: Open real-time tag view
actions.exact_action: Open the Ignition gateway tag application and access the real-time tag view.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop the diagnostic and escalate to L2 support if the Ignition tag application cannot show the real-time tag view.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The tags are checked through the tag application as real-time tags rather than through a Perspective project.

steps.title: Locate the mapped tag providers and groups
steps.purpose: Confirm that the mapped provider and group structure needed for tipper, hospital, and system tags is visible.
steps.instruction: In the Ignition gateway tag application, locate the mapped providers or groups named AvevaTest, GLDStation1a, GLDStation1b, GLDStation2a, GLDStation2b, Hospital1, TIPPERS, and SYS1.
steps.expected_result: The named mapped providers or groups are present in the Ignition tag tree or tag list.
steps.healthy_condition: The expected provider or group names are visible and can be expanded or inspected.
steps.failure_condition: One or more required providers or groups are absent or unavailable in the Ignition tag application.

actions.label: Inspect mapped providers
actions.exact_action: Locate AvevaTest, GLDStation1a, GLDStation1b, GLDStation2a, GLDStation2b, Hospital1, TIPPERS, and SYS1.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop the diagnostic and escalate to L2 support if required tag providers or groups are absent.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR lists AvevaTest, GLDStation1a, GLDStation1b, GLDStation2a, GLDStation2b, Hospital1, TIPPERS, and SYS1 as Ignition mappings.

steps.title: Inspect representative tipper tags
steps.purpose: Verify that representative tipper station and TS tags are mapped and exposing live values.
steps.instruction: In the Ignition gateway tag application, inspect representative tags including TipperStation1a, TipperStation1b, TipperStation2a, TipperStation2b, and the TS_1A through TS_8B tags.
steps.expected_result: The representative TipperStation and TS tags are present and display readable real-time values.
steps.healthy_condition: The tags are visible, readable, and show current values in the Ignition real-time view.
steps.failure_condition: A representative tag is absent, unavailable, unreadable, or has no live value.

actions.label: Check tipper tag values
actions.exact_action: Check TipperStation1a, TipperStation1b, TipperStation2a, TipperStation2b, and TS_1A through TS_8B for displayed real-time values.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop the diagnostic and escalate to L2 support if the representative tipper tags are absent or unavailable.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR lists TipperStation1a through TipperStation8b and TS_1A through TS_8B in the Ignition tag mapping.

steps.title: Inspect Hospital1 and SYS1 tags
steps.purpose: Verify that hospital-related tags and SYS1 metric-derived tags are available for live system use.
steps.instruction: In the Ignition gateway tag application, inspect the Hospital1 and SYS1 areas for readable tags. Treat SYS1 as the mapped area where metrics are converted into tags for AVEVA to read.
steps.expected_result: Hospital1 and SYS1-related tags are present and readable in the Ignition real-time tag view.
steps.healthy_condition: Hospital1 tags and SYS1 metric-derived tags are visible with readable live values.
steps.failure_condition: Hospital1 or SYS1-related tags are absent, unavailable, or unreadable.

actions.label: Check hospital and system tags
actions.exact_action: Check Hospital1 and SYS1-related tags for presence and readable real-time values.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop the diagnostic and escalate to L2 support if Hospital1 or SYS1-related tags cannot be displayed.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: SYS1 is where metrics are converted to tags for AVEVA to read; Hospital1 and SYS1 appear in the Ignition mapping.

steps.title: Confirm live tag readability and updating
steps.purpose: Determine whether the mapped tags are functioning as live real-time values rather than merely being listed.
steps.instruction: In the Ignition gateway tag application, verify that the required tipper, Hospital1, and SYS1 tags remain readable and show updating or otherwise current real-time values. Do not change tag values or configuration.
steps.expected_result: The required mapped tags are readable and updating or otherwise available as current real-time tag values.
steps.healthy_condition: Required tags remain present and readable in the Ignition real-time view, with values that update or otherwise indicate current availability.
steps.failure_condition: Values are absent, unavailable, unreadable, or do not update as real-time tag values.

actions.label: Verify live values
actions.exact_action: Confirm that the required tags are readable and changing or otherwise updating as real-time tag values.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop the diagnostic and escalate to L2 support if mapped values do not update or the Ignition tag application cannot show them.
Do not attempt corrective tag writes or configuration changes as part of this procedure.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The segment directs support to use the Ignition tag application to check real-time tags; the mapping supports OptiSweep communication and AVEVA-readable tags.

success_criteria: The Ignition gateway tag application opens to the real-time tag view.
AvevaTest, GLDStation1a, GLDStation1b, GLDStation2a, GLDStation2b, Hospital1, TIPPERS, and SYS1 mappings are visible.
Representative TipperStation and TS_1A through TS_8B tags are present and readable.
Hospital1 and SYS1-related tags are present and readable.
Required values update or otherwise remain available as current real-time tag values.
healthy_conditions: The Ignition gateway tag application is accessible.
Mapped provider and group names are visible.
Tipper, Hospital1, and SYS1 tags display readable real-time values.
SYS1-related metric-derived tags are available for downstream AVEVA reading.
failure_conditions: The Ignition tag application or real-time tag view cannot be opened.
Required tag providers or groups are absent.
Representative tipper, Hospital1, or SYS1 tags are absent or unavailable.
Displayed values are unreadable or do not update as real-time values.
escalation_guidance: Escalate to L2 support when the Ignition tag application cannot display the mapped tags or when values do not update.
Provide the affected provider or group name and tag name, if identifiable.
No corrective steps, API endpoint, command, threshold, or tag-provider reconfiguration is defined by this source.
